knowledge_gaps: Training-prefix targets may already have been optimized during training. Their diagnostic results measure fitted-model sensitivity, not generalization; the report needs an explicit limitation and a separate validation confirmation plan.

Removing and repacking interactions changes positional embeddings and adjacency as well as evidence. Recent-versus-older comparisons therefore need position-aware controls. Exact removal sizes, shuffle windows, prefix sampling, tie handling, and candidate counts remain unspecified.

The implementation does not explain four-dataset routing, deterministic sampling without changing training RNG state, or how auxiliary sampled diagnostics coexist with the required full-catalog recommendations for twenty users. Difficulty 3/10 appears optimistic, and potential 8/10 lacks measured support.
